title: Bibi Zehra ki hai rukhsati
body:
Bibi Zehra ki hai rukhsati
Ho mubarak tumhe ya nabi, bibi zehra ki hai rukhsati
doolha haider(a.s.) Bana zehra(s.a.) Dulhan bani
ho mubarak tumhay ya nabi(s.a.w.w)
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj zahra(s.a) ki hai rukhsati
mubarak mubarak mubarak mubarak
is kay chehray ka ghaza bani hai haya
is kay mathey ka jhoomar hai alhamd ka
<<DIVIDER>>
innama iskay hathon ka kangan bana
dekhye tu guloo band hai kulkafa
khalq may na mili aisi dulhan koi
ayaton say libase uroosi bana
<<DIVIDER>>
nor chehray pay aya hai wal fajr ka
or kalai ka zevar bani hai hal ata
goshwaray muzzamil kay hain ba khuda(j.j)
saj gayin fatima(s.a) parh kay nad-e-ali(a.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj dharti falak say siwa hogaye
yeh zameen ka muqaddar bhi dekhay koi
sab yahan agaye khuld khali hui
aaj khair-un-nisa(s.a.) Aisi dulhan bani
<<DIVIDER>>
aisa dulha bana aaj haq(j.j.) Ka wali(a.s.)
Aisa dulha kahan aisi dulhan kahan
jin ki khushyun may shamil hain kon-0-makaa'n
jagmaganay lagi arsh per kehkashan
<<DIVIDER>>
chand denay laga aaj khud hi azaan
muskara kar sada yeh sitaroo'n nay di
momino kay liyay hai khushi ki khabar
gehma gehmi machi hai payamber(s.a.w.w) kay ghar
<<DIVIDER>>
khush hain salmano miqdaro boozar udhar
shadmani hai chehron pay sub kay magar
jalnay walon kay dil per churi chal gay
tehniyat ko chalay arsh say anmbyaa(a.s.)
<<DIVIDER>>
Aur mohammad(s.a.w.w) kay dar per kia jhamghata
aakay jibraeel(a.s) nay arsh say yeh kaha
keh raha hai khuda(j.j) ay habib-e-khuda(s.a.w.w)
le kay baarat ko arahay hain ali(a.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
le kay barat sher-e-khuda aa gay
lenay apni dulhan (s.a) murtaza (a.s) aa gay
milne haider (a.s) say sub anbiya (a.s) aa gay
peshwai ko khud mustafa (s.a.w.w) aa gay
<<DIVIDER>>
mara jibraeel(a.s),mara jibraeel(a.s) nar-e-haidery
ya aliiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiii (a.s)
phir wo lamhe khushi kay qareeb aa gay
mustafa (s.a.w.w) sikgha-e-aqd parhnay lagay
<<DIVIDER>>
khud ba khud lafz saray qasidaye banay
sub marhil bahusn o khushi tay howay
marzi-e-kibriya haq mehr ban gaiye
gungunati fizah gungunati hawa
<<DIVIDER>>
agay agay barat kay hain anbiya (a.s)
aur khadija (s.a) ne anchal ka saya kia
khum kay saghar chlaknay lagay jah bajah
beti (s.a) rukhsat howi ,ankh num ho gai
<<DIVIDER>>
kis qadr khus hain farhan o zill-e-raza
haq-e-midhat bhi yun ho raha hai adda
us (a.s) ki zojah (s.a) bani hai aaj khair-ul-nisa (s.a)
jis ko kehtay hain sub mazhr-e-kibriya
<<DIVIDER>>
shor-e-sale allah mein howi rukhsati
author: Farhan Ali
